script.title: A CARD FOR ELI
script.story_hook: A new teen joins the local library.
script.intro_zh: 一位剛搬來的少年，到鎮上的圖書館辦借書證。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we get a library card. Listen for rules and codes.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們到圖書館辦借書證。留意規則與密碼的說法。
script.outro: Card in hand, books ahead. See you!
script.outro_zh: 借書證到手，好書在前方。再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each library phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，逐句跟讀圖書館的常用句。
script.char_a_description: a teenage boy of eighteen with short spiky bleached-blond hair and a small nose stud, wearing an oversized college hoodie, baggy jeans and red high-top sneakers, lanky build with bouncy energy
script.char_b_description: a woman in her sixties with a silver chin-length bob and gold hoop earrings, wearing a plum cardigan over an ivory blouse, a long floral skirt and comfortable flat shoes, plump and gentle

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! I just moved here. I'd like a library card.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ dʒʌst muːvd hɪɹ aɪd laɪk ə ˈlaɪbɛɹi kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 你好！我才剛搬來，想辦一張借書證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome to town! First time here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm tə taʊn fɜɹst taɪm hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎來到我們小鎮！第一次來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. The building looked too nice to pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ lʊkt tu naɪs tə pæs/
dialogue.zh: 對。這棟建築漂亮得讓我想進來看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice. Do you read for fun or school?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tʃɔɪs du ju rid fɔɹ fʌn ɔɹ skul/
dialogue.zh: 好選擇。你讀書是為興趣還是為學業？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both, honestly. Mostly books for fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ˈɑnəstli ˈmoʊstli bʊks fɔɹ fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 兩者都有，說實話。為興趣讀得比較多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you'll love it here. Card rules are easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju lʌv ɪt hɪɹ kɑɹd ɹulz ɑɹ ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 那你會喜歡這裡。辦證規定很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. I really hate long forms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪ ˈɹili heɪt ˈlɔŋ fɔɹmz/
dialogue.zh: 太好啦，我最怕填長長的表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! So, ID and proof of address.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ soʊ ˌaɪˈdi ænd pruf ʌv əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！請準備身分證和住所證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my ID. Proof of address... hmm.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz maɪ ˌaɪˈdi pruf ʌv əˈdɹɛs hʌm/
dialogue.zh: 身分證在這裡。住所證明……嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A utility bill works. Got one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə juˈtɪləti bɪl wɜɹks ɡɑt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 一張水電帳單就行。你有帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe my wifi contract counts?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi maɪ ˈwaɪfaɪ ˈkɑnˌtrækt kaʊnts/
dialogue.zh: 那我的網路合約算不算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does! Show me the address line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz ʃoʊ mi ði əˈdɹɛs laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 算！給我看看地址那一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here. Twenty-First Street, Apartment 3B.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ˈtwɛnti fɜɹst stɹit əˈpɑɹtmənt θɹi bi/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡。二十一街，3B號公寓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Now a photo for the file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt naʊ ə ˈfoʊtoʊ fɔɹ ðə faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。再拍一張照片存檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A photo? Like right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfoʊtoʊ laɪk ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 拍照？就現在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, on your phone is fine. Front, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɑn jʊɹ foʊn ɪz faɪn fɹʌnt pliz/
dialogue.zh: 對，用手機拍就好。正面，麻煩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Oh, that flash surprised me.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs oʊ ðæt flæʃ sɚˈpɹaɪzd mi/
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？噢，那道光嚇了我一跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry! The screen light, not a real flash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi ðə skɪn laɪt nɑt ə ɹil flæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉！是螢幕的光，不是真的閃光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, no worries. Can I try again?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ noʊ ˈwɜɹiz kæn aɪ traɪ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，不要緊。我能再拍一張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Chin up, nice and calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs tʃɪn ʌp naɪs ænd kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。下巴抬起來，自然一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it? Do I look famous?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt du aɪ lʊk ˈfeɪməs/
dialogue.zh: 拍好了嗎？我看上去像明星嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very famous. Okay, this part matters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛɹi ˈfeɪməs oʊˈkeɪ ðɪs pɑɹt ˈmætɚz/
dialogue.zh: 很有明星相。好啦，接下來最重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fine policy? Let me guess...
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə faɪn ˈpɑləsi lɛt mi ɡɛs/
dialogue.zh: 罰款規定嗎？讓我猜猜……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You guess fast! Two weeks, no renewal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɛs fæst tu wikz noʊ ɹɪˈnul/
dialogue.zh: 你猜得真快！借期兩週，無法延期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait — no renewals at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt noʊ ɹɪˈnulz ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 等等——一次都不能延嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None. But look, due dates print nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn bʊt lʊk du deɪts pɹɪnt ˈnaɪsli/
dialogue.zh: 一張都不能。不過看，到期日印得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good. My memory needs that help.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd maɪ ˈmɛməɹi nidz ðæt hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 那好。我的記憶力正需要幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We all do. Six items at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɔl du sɪks ˈɪtəmz æt ə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 大家都一樣。一次最多借六本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six! I expected maybe two.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks aɪ ɪkˈspɛktɪd ˈmeɪbi tu/
dialogue.zh: 六本！我本來以為只有兩本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two was the old rule. We upgraded.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wʌz ði oʊld ɹul wi ˈʌpˌɡɹeɪdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 兩本是舊規定，現在升級囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Is there an app for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ɪz ðɛɹ ən æp fɔɹ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 真好。有對應的App嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Scan your card, see due dates.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs skæn jʊɹ kɑɹd si du deɪts/
dialogue.zh: 有！掃一下借書證，就能看到到期日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the app show the wifi code too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ði æp ʃoʊ ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ koʊd tu/
dialogue.zh: 那個App也會顯示wifi密碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! No, that's on the little blue sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ noʊ ðæts ɑn ðə ˈlɪtl̩ blu saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！那個寫在藍色小牌子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue sign... I see it! Library, all lowercase.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu saɪn aɪ si ɪt ˈlaɪbɛɹi ɔl ˈloʊɚˌkæseɪ/
dialogue.zh: 藍色牌子……看到了！全是小寫字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the guest code. It changes monthly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ɡɛst koʊd ɪt ˈtʃeɪndʒəz ˈmʌnθli/
dialogue.zh: 那是訪客密碼，每月更新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing. My data is almost gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ maɪ ˈdetə ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst ɡɔn/
dialogue.zh: 時間剛好。我的手機流量快用完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time. Nobody minds laptops here.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊɹ taɪm ˈnoʊbəˌdi maɪndz ˈlæptɑps hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢用，沒人會介意你用筆電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more... what about fines here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ wʌt əˈbaʊt faɪnz hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 再問一個……那罰款呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just late books. Ten cents a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst leɪt bʊks tɛn sɛnts ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 只有逾期書，一天罰十美分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only ten cents? That's friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tɛn sɛnts ðæts ˈfɹɛndli/
dialogue.zh: 只要十美分？還算客氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very. We'd rather nudge than punish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛɹi wi d ˈɹæðɚ nʌdʒ ðæn ˈpʌnɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我們寧可提醒，也不願重罰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good system. Do kids need their own cards?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈsɪstəm du kɪdz nid ðɛr oʊn kɑɹdz/
dialogue.zh: 好制度。小朋友要單獨辦證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, free for under twelve. One form.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fri fɔɹ ˈʌndɚ twɛlv wʌn fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 要，十二歲以下免費，填一張表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a little cousin. I'll tell him.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈlɪtl̩ ˈkʌzən aɪl tɛl hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我有個小表弟，我回去告訴他。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do. Now, your card... printing!
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du naʊ jʊɹ kɑɹd ˈpɹɪntɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好呀。你的借書證……正在列印！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was fast. Can I check out now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz fæst kæn aɪ tʃɛk aʊt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好快。我現在就能借書了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go for it. The new arrivals shelf, first right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ fɔɹ ɪt ðə nju əˈɹaɪvəz ʃɛlf fɜɹst ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 請便。新書書架，右轉第一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ooh, they have the graphic novels I like.
dialogue.phonetic: /u ðeɪ hæv ðə ɡɹæˈfɪk ˈnɑvəlz aɪ laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 哇，有我愛看的圖像小說！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A whole shelf of them. And audiobooks, free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hoʊl ʃɛlf ʌv ðəm ænd ˈɔdioʊˌbʊks fri/
dialogue.zh: 整整一架子。有聲書也是免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free audiobooks? Jogging just got better.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈɔdioʊˌbʊks dʒɑɡɪŋ dʒʌst ɡɑt bɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 免費有聲書？我跑步的時候不無聊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! That's the spirit. Eli on the card, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts ðə ˈspɪɹət ˈɛli ɑn ðə kɑɹd ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！就是這氣氛。卡上寫伊萊，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eli. New last name, actually. Short for Elijah.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛli nju læst neɪm ˈæktʃuəli ʃɔɹ fɔɹ ɪˈlaɪdʒə/
dialogue.zh: 伊萊。其實我才改的姓，全名是以利亞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet the real Elijah.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə mit ðə ɹil ɪˈlaɪdʒə/
dialogue.zh: 認識真正的以利亞，真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You too. And thanks for your patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu ænd θæŋks fɔɹ jʊɹ ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 我也一樣。謝謝你的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the way, the quiet room is upstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ ðə ˈkwaɪət ɹum ɪz ˌʌpˈstɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 對了，安靜閱讀室在樓上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quiet room? That's where I'll live.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwaɪət ɹum ðæts wɛɹ aɪl lɪv/
dialogue.zh: 安靜閱讀室？我大概會常住那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's all yours. The card's fresh off the printer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɔl jʊɹz ðə kɑɹdz fɹɛʃ ɔf ðə ˈpɹɪntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 送給你啦。借書證剛出爐，還熱騰騰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm already planning my first six books.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ɔlˈrɛdi ˈplænɪŋ maɪ fɜɹst sɪks bʊks/
dialogue.zh: 我已經在計畫前六本要借什麼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush. The library isn't going anywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɹʌʃ ðə ˈlaɪbɛɹi ˈɪznt ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈɛnɪˌwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢挑，圖書館又不會跑掉。

script.youtube_title_en: "Jogging Just Got Better" — Getting a Library Card in a Small Town
script.youtube_description:
60句圖書館聽力練習：剛搬來小鎮，怎麼辦一張借書證？借多久、罰多少、wifi密碼在哪？

這一集跟著一位十八歲的新居民，從出示身分證、手機拍大頭照，一路聽到借期與續借規定、逾期罰款、訪客密碼、有聲書與圖像小說的藏書。中途還有一個讓螢幕亮光嚇一跳的小插曲。

你會聽到：
- 辦證時問證件與地址的問句
- 借期、到期日、罰款的說法
- 查wifi密碼與App功能短句
- 借用館內空間的禮貌問法

60 lines of library listening practice: a teenager who just moved to town asks for his first library card. At the desk he learns the ID rules, photo step, loan period, fine policy, guest wifi code, and the free audiobooks waiting on the shelf.

You will hear how to prove your address, ask about due dates, and chat about books, then review every line with shadowing practice.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

script.thumbnail_action: holding up a brand-new library card
